title: Inside Google DeepMind's Reshuffle After CEO Demis Hassabis Steps Aside
excerpt: Demis Hassabis' move to a new Google role is part of a broader DeepMind reorganization, according to people familiar with the changes, as leadership shifts and teams are restructured.
content_html:
Demis Hassabis, the founder and CEO of Google’s artificial intelligence division DeepMind, is stepping aside to a more advisory role, Google announced on Wednesday. Hassabis will become DeepMind’s chair, and take a new role as chief scientist at Google parent Alphabet. 

The move comes alongside a broader restructuring of Google DeepMind, according to multiple people familiar with the changes, as Google attempts to catch up to industry leaders OpenAI and Anthropic.

In a note to staff, Hassabis said he believed that artificial general intelligence (AGI) is “close at hand” and said he had decided to switch roles “so that I have the time and space to focus on the big picture and help influence what is to come to the best of my ability.” 

Although the news shocked the AI industry, some DeepMind employees suggested it made sense. Hassabis had spent less time on Gemini, Google’s struggling frontier AI model, in recent months, according to two people with knowledge of his focus, and was spending more time on questions of safety and what the arrival of AGI would mean for society.

Other changes are accompanying his move. Lila Ibrahim, DeepMind’s Chief AI Readiness Officer, will now report to James Manyika, a senior Google executive, according to four people with knowledge of the personnel changes. Some of the teams that previously reported to her, including some safety teams, will now report to Kent Walker, Google’s president of global affairs, one of these people said, though two others warned that no decision has yet been finalized. 

One DeepMind employee told TIME they were worried that if teams focused on safety, responsibility and ethics were moved from DeepMind into Google, they may lose their influence. 

"To be clear, in terms of frontier AI safety, this transition changes absolutely nothing," a Google spokesperson said in a statement to TIME.

Comms, legal and marketing teams from DeepMind will merge with those within Google, according to a person with knowledge of the matter. Shane Legg, a DeepMind cofounder and its chief AGI scientist, will continue reporting to Hassabis, along with a wider team, according to the same person.

Hassabis’ departure comes at a time when Gemini has faced repeated delays, and fallen behind models from OpenAI and Anthropic at the frontier. Google is also losing top talent at a rapid pace. On Wednesday its longtime chief scientist Jeff Dean announced he was leaving with several colleagues to launch a startup. John Jumper, a scientist who shared a Nobel Prize with Hassabis for AI protein structure prediction, left DeepMind earlier this year to join Anthropic, among other high-profile departures.

Koray Kavukcuoglu, DeepMind’s chief technology officer, will replace Hassabis at the helm of DeepMind, though in a senior vice president position rather than as CEO, Google boss Sundar Pichai wrote in a memo on Wednesday. 

Kavukcuoglu had been taking responsibility for the development of Gemini long before Wednesday’s news. In company briefings, Kavukcuoglu would lead Gemini discussions, and Hassabis had been absent from many day-to-day meetings about Gemini, attending only for the most significant ones, one DeepMind employee tells TIME. Meanwhile, Hassabis was regularly present for meetings about post-AGI readiness, safety, and AI governance, the person said, and was spending more of his time working with governments, including attending the recent G7 summit.

"Koray’s philosophy has always been clear: advancing the frontier of AI and building it responsibly are the exact same mission," a Google spokesperson said in a statement. "Frontier model safety has lived directly within the Gemini team from the very beginning, under Koray’s leadership. His teams collaborate closely with the safety and policy teams across Google and Google DeepMind, and that will continue."

Semafor earlier reported that Hassabis had been shifting day-to-day responsibility for Gemini and Google’s consumer AI strategy to Kavukcuoglu for at least a year. Hassabis was not pushed to change roles, the outlet reported, but had struggled to gain satisfaction from a role more focused on business than his main passion, science.

content_html_zh:
谷歌周三宣布，谷歌人工智能部门 DeepMind 的创始人兼首席执行官 Demis Hassabis 将辞去顾问职务。 哈萨比斯将成为 DeepMind 的主席，并担任谷歌母公司 Alphabet 的首席科学家。

据多位知情人士透露，此举与谷歌 DeepMind 进行更广泛的重组同时进行，谷歌试图追赶行业领导者 OpenAI 和 Anthropic。

哈萨比斯在给员工的一份说明中表示，他相信通用人工智能（AGI）“触手可及”，并表示他已决定转换角色，“以便我有时间和空间专注于大局，并尽我所能帮助影响未来的发展。”

尽管这一消息震惊了人工智能行业，但一些 DeepMind 员工表示这是有道理的。 据两位了解哈萨比斯关注重点的人士透露，近几个月来，哈萨比斯在谷歌苦苦挣扎的前沿人工智能模型 Gemini 上花费的时间较少，而将更多时间花在安全问题以及通用人工智能的到来对社会意味着什么上。

伴随他的举动还发生了其他变化。 据四位了解人事变动的人士透露，DeepMind 首席人工智能准备官 Lila Ibrahim 现在将向谷歌高级高管 James Manyika 汇报工作。 其中一位知情人士表示，之前向她汇报的一些团队，包括一些安全团队，现在将向谷歌全球事务总裁肯特·沃克汇报，不过另外两人警告称，尚未最终确定任何决定。

一位 DeepMind 员工告诉《时代》杂志，他们担心如果专注于安全、责任和道德的团队从 DeepMind 转移到谷歌，他们可能会失去影响力。

谷歌发言人在给《时代》杂志的一份声明中表示：“需要明确的是，就前沿人工智能安全而言，这种转变绝对不会改变任何事情。”

据知情人士透露，DeepMind 的通信、法律和营销团队将与谷歌内部的团队合并。 据同一人士透露，DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家 Shane Legg 将继续向 Hassabis 以及更广泛的团队汇报工作。

Hassabis 的离开正值 Gemini 面临一再延迟，并且在前沿落后于 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的模型之际。 谷歌也在快速流失顶尖人才。 周三，该公司长期担任首席科学家的杰夫·迪恩 (Jeff Dean) 宣布，他将与几位同事一起离职，创办一家初创公司。 因人工智能蛋白质结构预测与 Hassabis 共同获得诺贝尔奖的科学家 John Jumper 今年早些时候离开 DeepMind 加入 Anthropic，还有其他备受瞩目的离职事件。

谷歌老板桑达尔·皮查伊 (Sundar Pichai) 在周三的一份备忘录中写道，DeepMind 首席技术官 Koray Kavukcuoglu 将取代哈萨比斯 (Hassabis) 掌舵 DeepMind，不过他将担任高级副总裁而非首席执行官。

早在周三的新闻发布之前，卡武克措格鲁就一直负责 Gemini 的开发。 一位 DeepMind 员工告诉《时代》杂志，在公司简报中，卡武克措格鲁将主持 Gemini 的讨论，而哈萨比斯则缺席许多有关 Gemini 的日常会议，只参加最重要的会议。 该人士表示，与此同时，哈萨比斯定期出席有关后 AGI 准备、安全和人工智能治理的会议，并花更多时间与政府合作，包括参加最近的七国集团峰会。

谷歌发言人在一份声明中表示：“Koray 的理念一直很明确：推进人工智能前沿和负责任地构建人工智能是完全相同的使命。” “在 Koray 的领导下，前沿模型安全从一开始就直接存在于 Gemini 团队中。 他的团队与 Google 和 Google DeepMind 的安全和政策团队密切合作，这种合作将会持续下去。”

Semafor 早些时候报道称，哈萨比斯将 Gemini 和谷歌消费者人工智能战略的日常责任转移给 Kavukcuoglu 至少一年了。 据该媒体报道，哈萨比斯并没有被迫改变角色，但他一直在努力从一个更专注于商业而不是他主要爱好科学的角色中获得满足感。
